domain: Religious Studies / Biblical Hermeneutics / Science-Religion Interface
topic_summary: Analysis of the Genesis 1-2 creation narrative as a contested kernel where different hermeneutic traditions instantiate structurally distinct constraints. The canonical text describing six-day creation and human dominion serves as shared substrate, but literal young-earth and theistic evolutionary readings emit different constraint structures regarding cosmological timescales, evolutionary biology validity, and environmental ethics frameworks.

key_entities: Genesis 1-2 canonical text (Hebrew scripture; foundational creation narrative)
Young-Earth Creationist interpretive tradition (literal 24-hour days; 6000-10000 year timeline)
Theistic Evolutionary interpretive tradition (allegorical framework; deep-time compatible)
Scientific consensus on cosmology/evolution (13.8 billion year universe; 3.8 billion year biosphere)
Public education curriculum standards (venues where constraint collision manifests)
Environmental stewardship theology (derivative ethical framework dependent on dominion reading)
key_tensions: Literal chronology vs deep-time cosmology (YEC vs scientific consensus)
Divine fiat creation vs evolutionary mechanisms (special creation vs natural selection)
Dominion-as-exploitation vs dominion-as-stewardship (anthropocentric vs ecocentric ethics)
key_mechanisms: Curricular gatekeeping: State education boards adjudicating which reading's constraints govern biology instruction
Hermeneutic authority structures: Denominational hierarchies enforcing interpretive fidelity to chosen reading
key_absences: Jewish interpretive traditions (Midrash, Kabbalah) treating Genesis as non-historical mythopoetic literature
Process theology readings rejecting ex nihilo creation entirely

commitment_system_recognition.kernel_description: Genesis 1-2 canonical text describing six-day creation sequence and human dominion mandate
commitment_system_recognition.authority_description: Denominational/scholarly hermeneutic traditions claiming legitimacy through textual fidelity or scientific compatibility

readings.commitment: Genesis 1-2 as inerrant historical-scientific chronicle; 24-hour days; recent creation
readings.authority_grounding: Scriptural inerrancy doctrine; Reformed/Fundamentalist hermeneutic tradition
readings.expected_structural_delta: Evolution categorically false; high suppression of non-literalist readings in conservative institutions; dominion read as exploitation license

readings.commitment: Genesis 1-2 as theological framework compatible with scientific cosmology; days as epochs or literary device
readings.authority_grounding: Faith-science integration movements; mainline Protestant/Catholic Magisterium compatibility
readings.expected_structural_delta: Evolution theologically permissible; low suppression of scientific consensus; dominion read as stewardship ethic

readings.commitment: Genesis 1-2 as Ancient Near Eastern mythopoetic literature; no historical-scientific claims
readings.authority_grounding: Historical-critical biblical scholarship; comparative mythology framework
readings.expected_structural_delta: Text has no adjudicative authority over cosmology/biology; complete decoupling from science; dominion metaphor loses normative force

axiom_contradictions.basis: Inerrancy axiom (text cannot err on material facts) vs accommodation axiom (divine communication uses pre-scientific frameworks) are mutually exclusive—no framework holds both simultaneously
Divine authorship axiom (text conveys God's factual account) vs human authorship axiom (text reflects ancient human cosmology) cannot coexist—one requires rejecting the other's ontological claim

axes.structural_delta: Genesis 1-2 read as inerrant historical-scientific chronicle emitting constraints of recent creation, anti-evolutionary biology policy, and exploitative dominion theology
axes.primary_observable: Denominational position statements on biblical inerrancy; curriculum standards excluding evolutionary biology; environmental theology treating nature as instrumental resource
axes.selection_reason: First reading selected: highest extractiveness; clearest beneficiary/victim structure; institutional suppression mechanisms

axes.structural_delta: Genesis 1-2 read as theological framework compatible with deep time emitting constraints permitting evolutionary biology and stewardship-based environmental ethics
axes.primary_observable: Mainline denominational statements endorsing evolution; theological bioethics literature citing Genesis for ecological responsibility; science-faith integration curricula
axes.selection_reason: Second reading selected: moderate extractiveness; structurally distinct from literal_young_earth (coordination rope vs suppression snare); represents licensed plurality

axes.structural_delta: Genesis 1-2 read as mythopoetic literature decoupling text from cosmological/biological authority entirely
axes.primary_observable: Historical-critical biblical scholarship adoption rates; secularization of environmental ethics (non-theological framings); interfaith dialogue treating Genesis as cultural artifact
axes.selection_reason: Third reading selected: completes triadic structure; scaffold hypothesis tests whether full decoupling is stable or collapses back into faith-science coordination

omegas.description: Jewish interpretive traditions (Talmudic, Midrashic, Kabbalistic) absent from analysis. These traditions historically treated Genesis as non-literal centuries before Christian debates, potentially invalidating Christian readings' claim to hermeneutic originality. Absence may reflect Christian-centric framing of the kernel.

Process theology readings rejecting ex nihilo creation (God as persuader not controller) absent. If this reading gains traction, it may reclassify the kernel itself from 'creation account' to 'divine-world relationship metaphor,' collapsing all three selected readings.

Environmental ethics (dominion-as-exploitation vs dominion-as-stewardship) treated as derivative of creation reading, but may be independent axis with own epsilon. Ecotheology movements may reconstruct dominion ethics without resolving Genesis chronology debates.

Intelligent Design movement (ID) attempts to decouple anti-evolutionism from Genesis literalism, positioning as scientific rather than religious. If successful, literal_young_earth reading's constraint structure partially transfers to ID framework, but with different authority grounding (scientific falsification claims vs scriptural inerrancy). Not analyzed as separate reading due to contested scientific legitimacy.

Allegorical_ancient_near_east reading classified as scaffold, but stability uncertain. Historical-critical scholarship has institutional foothold in seminaries but limited congregational uptake. May be piton (atrophied authority) rather than scaffold (emerging coordination) if secularization continues.

fracture_scan.notes: No fractures detected. Three readings selected capture structural diversity: high-epsilon snare (literal_young_earth), moderate-epsilon rope (theistic_evolutionary), low-epsilon scaffold (allegorical_ancient_near_east). Axiom contradictions declared for literal_young_earth vs both alternatives. Jewish interpretive traditions and process theology flagged as omega-level absences.
